description: A loop start that arrives while the daemon is shutting down is REFUSED before any row exists (S55 T4, LC19): the daemon is going away, so a loop born into the drain would die at its first step and its row would read running for nothing. The refusal is TYPED, not a transport failure — the daemon understood and declined — and it says what it did not do (nothing was written); the advice is to restart the daemon and start again, because resending into the dying daemon changes nothing.

error.message: the loop control refused the operation

data.what: loop start refused: the daemon is shutting down and will not accept new loop work — restart it, then start again
data.means: the daemon understood and declined — nothing was written and nothing moved
